plugins.name: obedient-ai
plugins.description: Loads standing rules at session start, guards against dangerous git, foreground sleeps and pip install, and ships the polish, learn-logs, marketing and post skills.

plugins.name: token-guard
plugins.description: Warns on long sessions and trims wasteful Reads and repeated Bash calls.

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps the prompt cache warm in long idle sessions with cheap pings, then compacts.

plugins.name: quickrun
plugins.description: Runs short command prompts (commit, push, run, test, deploy, typos included) directly, without a main-model turn.
